# Copilot Orchestrator

> Multi-agent orchestration system for GitHub Copilot with 16 specialized agents

## Overview

This repository implements a structured multi-agent orchestration pattern for VS Code GitHub Copilot. It provides agent definitions, reusable prompt templates, layered instructions, Agent Skills, and validation tooling for coordinating complex development workflows.

## Architecture

- **Lifecycle:** Conductor → Planner → Implementer → Reviewer → Completion
- **Agents:** 16 specialized agents in `.github/agents/` (11 core + 5 translation) covering planning, implementation, review, ops, testing, infrastructure, documentation, UX, and translation
- **Skills:** 12 Agent Skills in `.github/skills/` providing domain expertise (TDD, security review, performance analysis, delegation routing, accessibility, etc.)
- **Instructions:** 15 layered instruction files in `instructions/` (global, workflow, compliance, language-specific)
- **Prompts:** 22 reusable prompt templates in `.github/prompts/` organized by workflow phase
- **Model Tiers:** Security-only premium (GPT-5.3-Codex/4.7 override), Execution (GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5.3-Codex), Fast (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4 mini)

## Key Files

- `AGENTS.md` — Agent roster, lifecycle, model allocation, safety guardrails
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — Workspace-level Copilot instructions
- `instructions/global/` — Global behavior, security, quality, model selection rules
- `instructions/workflows/` — Per-agent workflow contracts
- `docs/guides/vscode-copilot-configuration.md` — Complete VS Code setup guide
- `scripts/` — PowerShell 5.1 validation and tooling scripts
- `docs/templates/` — Plan, phase-complete, and plan-complete templates

## Specialized Workflows

- **Translation System:** 5 agents for cross-language code translation with dependency analysis, pattern mapping, and 6-layer validation
- **Conductor Orchestration:** Full lifecycle management with mandatory pause points for human approval
